name: Galaxy S25 Ultra

body.sim: nano + eSIM + eSIM (max 2 at a time, INT)

soc.name: Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy
soc.npu: not listed on the GSMArena spec page
soc.ram: 12 GB (256/512 GB/1 TB) or 16 GB (1 TB)

battery.charge: 45 W wired (65 % in 30 min), 15 W wireless (Qi2 Ready), 4.5 W reverse

extras: Vapor chamber 40 % larger than the S24 Ultra (Samsung claim, via teardown coverage)
Stylus listed (S Pen, no Bluetooth per teardown coverage)

design.front: slim bezels; flat Ultra display; ultrasonic under-display fingerprint

frame.cornerNote: measured on the GSMArena render (silhouette fit: top-left 5.5, top-right 6.0, bottom-right 5.3 mm; the other corners are hidden behind the second phone)

back.note: colors: Titanium Silver Blue, Black, White Silver, Gray, Jade Green, Jet Black, Pink Gold

island.kind: no island: five separate lens openings, each in its own raised metal ring; three large in a left column, two small beside them, flash between the small ones
island.layout: 3 large rings + 2 small, flash in between (measured on the render)
island.raiseConf: measured on the render side view (rings stand about 2.9 mm); PhoneArena lists 9.1 mm with the bump, which would be 0.9 mm: the sources conflict and the render was used
island.laser: one of the two small openings (leak coverage: laser AF, LED flash and the 3x tele sit in the second column)
island.ringStyle: thick individual rings (the 'vinyl record' look Samsung dropped on the S26 Ultra)
island.whichIs: Samsung does not say which opening is which camera: leaks put main, ultrawide and periscope in the big column, 3x tele and laser AF in the small one; the order is estimated

buttons.right: volume rocker + power, measured on the side render

design.bottom: S Pen slot, USB-C, SIM tray, down-firing speaker
design.sPen: S Pen present; size and slot position not published: estimated

extra: no Privacy Display: that layer is new in the S26 Ultra (Samsung)

layout.src: GSMArena product render (back, front and side views), scale from the published height 162.8 mm = 648 px (0.2512 mm/px); front width cross-check +1.3 %

lenses.idConf: estimated: Samsung does not say which opening is which

extras.note: upper small opening: laser AF (estimated from leak coverage)

interior.conf: estimated: no photo of the S25 Ultra interior could be read; layout follows teardown facts (modular camera assemblies, battery with pull tabs, sealed S Pen chamber) and assumes the same arrangement as the S26 Ultra
